title: Closed Areas Regulation, Schedule 7, section 49 (Khutzeymateen Park)

source.version: BC Laws consolidation current to October 13, 2026

source_text:
Schedule 7 No Hunting Areas (Section 8)
Khutzeymateen Park
49 That portion of M.U. 6-14 within the boundaries of Khutzeymateen Park below the 1 000 metre elevation. [en. B.C. Reg. 151/2006, s. 5 (c).]
